positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
I'm on charge of a monthly event that helps teams moving from on-premise solutions to cloud platforms like Cloud Foundry (Kubernetes or PaaS) and AWS.
Each application teams has it's own challenges like needed availability, resiliency, data confidentiality and other restrictions (bank policies and country's legal restrictions), my role here is guide them in their journey and work with specialist when needed.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineering
positions.locationName: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
positions.description:
Working in a Developer role in an Agile team with responsibilities over two projects, one legacy and the other one more modern (cloud based).
Using technologies such as Spring (Core, AOP, JMS, JDBC), jUnit, H2, React.
Working with GIT, Maven, Jules pipelines deploying into Tomcat and Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PaaS).
